mapper.select: select p.id,p.scientific_name,p.common_name,p.cover_img,p.difficulty,p.created_at, g.light_requirements,g.watering_frequency,g.temperature_preference, g.humidity_preference,g.fertilizing_tips,g.detail_advice from plants p left join plant_care_guides g on p.id = g.plant_id where p.common_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') order by p.created_at desc

select p.scientific_name,p.common_name,p.cover_img,p.difficulty,p.created_at, g.light_requirements,g.watering_frequency,g.temperature_preference, g.humidity_preference,g.fertilizing_tips,g.detail_advice from plants p left join plant_care_guides g on p.id = g.plant_id where p.id = #{id}
